entities.summary: The Karpenko-Karyi State Museum-Reserve "Khutir Nadiia" is a national historic reserve in Ukraine that was established on a territory of estate that belonged to Ivan Karpenko-Karyi, the playwright and theatrical figure of the late 19th – early 20th century.
